fullPassage: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors. Rich mathematical discussions cannot occur if this expectation is not in place. We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the forefront, we cannot help students confront their thinking. Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk sharing an incorrect answer over with their peers in order to grow mathematically. It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without derogatory comments. As educators we can model this by recording all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical expressions that indicate agreement or disagreement with any answer. The teacher may need to practice having a "blank face." Students look to teachers as the source of correct answers. Part of building a safe learning community is to shift this source of knowledge to the students by equipping them to defend the thinking behind their solutions.

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is (A)[acceptance / rejection] of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors. Rich mathematical discussions cannot occur if this (B)[expectation / limitation] is not in place. We must remember that wrong answers are often (C)[rooted / hidden] in misconceptions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 존중하는 교실 공동체의 첫 단계는 모든 아이디어의 수용(acceptance)이며, 이 기대(expectation)가 없으면 수학적 토론이 불가하다. 틀린 답은 오개념에 뿌리를 둔(rooted) 경우가 많다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① acceptance — expectation — rooted: 원문과 일치
❌ ② rejection(거부): acceptance의 반의어
❌ ③ limitation(제한): expectation과 다른 의미
❌ ④ hidden(숨겨진): rooted와 다른 의미
det.tip: acceptance = 수용, expectation = 기대, be rooted in = ~에 뿌리를 두다

questions.passage: Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk (A)[sharing / concealing] an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically. It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without (B)[derogatory / encouraging] comments. As educators we can model this by (C)[recording / ignoring] all answers to be considered.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 안전한 학습 환경의 학생들은 틀린 답을 공유하려(sharing) 한다. 비하하는(derogatory) 댓글 없이 모든 아이디어를 수용하고, 교육자는 모든 답을 기록하여(recording) 모범을 보인다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② sharing — derogatory — recording: 원문과 일치
❌ ① concealing(숨기는): sharing의 반의어
❌ ③ encouraging(격려하는): derogatory의 반의어
❌ ④ ignoring(무시하는): recording의 반의어
det.tip: share = 공유하다, derogatory = 비하하는, record = 기록하다

questions.passage: The teacher may need to practice having a "blank face." Students look to teachers as the (A)[source / barrier] of correct answers. Part of building a safe learning community is to (B)[shift / maintain] this source of knowledge to the students by (C)[equipping / preventing] them to defend the thinking behind their solutions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 학생들은 교사를 정답의 원천(source)으로 본다. 안전한 공동체 구축의 일부는 이 지식의 원천을 학생에게 이동시키는(shift) 것이며, 학생들이 스스로 해결 사고를 방어하도록 갖추게 하는(equipping) 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ source — shift — equipping: 원문과 일치
❌ ① barrier(장벽): source와 다른 의미
❌ ② maintain(유지하다): shift의 반의어
❌ ④ preventing(막는): equipping의 반의어
det.tip: source = 원천, shift = 이동시키다, equip = 갖추게 하다

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is ①<u>acceptance</u> of all ideas and answers. Rich mathematical discussions cannot ②<u>occur</u> if this expectation is not in place. We must remember that wrong answers are often ③<u>rooted</u> in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the ④<u>background</u>, we cannot help students confront their thinking.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ background(배경) → forefront(전면): 오개념을 '전면'에 드러내야 학생의 사고를 교정할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① acceptance(수용): 원문 일치
✅ ② occur(발생하다): 원문 일치
✅ ③ rooted(뿌리를 둔): 원문 일치
❌ ④ background(배경): 원문은 forefront(전면) — 반의어로 교체됨
det.tip: forefront(전면, 최전선) ↔ background(배경)

questions.passage: Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk sharing an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically. As educators we can model this by recording all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical ①<u>expressions</u> that ②<u>indicate</u> agreement or ③<u>disagreement</u> with any answer. The teacher may need to practice having a ④<u>cheerful</u> face.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ cheerful(쾌활한) → blank(무표정한): 교사는 동의/비동의를 드러내지 않기 위해 '무표정한' 얼굴을 연습해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① expressions(표현): 원문 일치
✅ ② indicate(나타내다): 원문 일치
✅ ③ disagreement(불일치): 원문 일치
❌ ④ cheerful(쾌활한): 원문은 blank(무표정한) — 다른 의미로 교체됨
det.tip: blank face(무표정한 얼굴) ≠ cheerful face(쾌활한 얼굴)

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a ①<u>respectful</u> classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors. We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions. Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk sharing an ②<u>incorrect</u> answer over with their peers in order to grow mathematically. It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without ③<u>encouraging</u> comments. The teacher may need to practice having a ④<u>blank</u> face.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ encouraging(격려하는) → derogatory(비하하는): 모든 아이디어를 '비하하는' 댓글 없이 수용해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① respectful(존중하는): 원문 일치
✅ ② incorrect(틀린): 원문 일치
❌ ③ encouraging(격려하는): 원문은 derogatory(비하하는) — 반의어로 교체됨
✅ ④ blank(무표정한): 원문 일치
det.tip: derogatory(비하하는) ↔ encouraging(격려하는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 틀린 답은 오개념(misconceptions)에 뿌리를 둔 경우가 많다.
det.analysis:

❌ ① achievements(성취): 틀린 답과 무관
❌ ③ agreements(동의): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ celebrations(축하): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: misconception = 오개념, 잘못된 이해 (mis- + conception)

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비하하는(derogatory) 댓글 없이 모든 아이디어를 수용해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ derogatory(비하하는): 원문 일치 — 비하 발언 없이 수용
❌ ① constructive(건설적인): 긍정적 의미
❌ ② insightful(통찰력 있는): 긍정적 의미
❌ ④ supportive(지지하는): 긍정적 의미
det.tip: derogatory = 비하하는, 경멸적인

questions.passage: It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without derogatory comments. As educators we can model this by recording all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical expressions that indicate agreement or disagreement with any answer. The teacher may need to practice having a "blank face." Students look to teachers as the source of correct answers. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 학생들이 스스로 사고를 방어하도록 갖추게 하는(equipping) 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ equipping(갖추게 하다): 원문 일치 — 학생에게 능력을 부여
❌ ① forbidding(금지하다): 반대 의미
❌ ② discouraging(단념시키다): 반대 의미
❌ ③ isolating(고립시키다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: equip = 갖추게 하다 | equip A to V = A가 V할 수 있도록 준비시키다

questions.passage: We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the <u>forefront</u>, we cannot help students confront their thinking.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 forefront의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: forefront = 전면, center stage = 중심 무대 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② center stage(중심 무대): forefront의 동의어
❌ ① background(배경): 반의어
❌ ③ conclusion(결론): 다른 의미
❌ ④ margin(주변부): 반의어
det.tip: forefront = center stage = front and center = 전면, 최전선

questions.passage: Students who are in safe learning environments are willing to risk sharing an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically. It is important to model and expect the acceptance of all ideas without <u>derogatory</u> comments.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 derogatory의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: derogatory = 비하하는, disparaging = 경멸하는 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ① disparaging(경멸하는): derogatory의 동의어
❌ ② complimentary(칭찬하는): 반의어
❌ ③ neutral(중립적인): 다른 의미
❌ ④ enthusiastic(열정적인): 다른 의미
det.tip: derogatory = disparaging = belittling = 비하하는, 경멸적인

questions.passage: We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the forefront, we cannot help students <u>confront</u> their thinking.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 confront의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: confront = 직면하다, face = 마주하다 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ face(마주하다): confront의 동의어
❌ ① avoid(피하다): 반의어
❌ ② forget(잊다): 다른 의미
❌ ④ repeat(반복하다): 다른 의미
det.tip: confront = face = 직면하다, 마주하다

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a <u>respectful</u> classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 respectful의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: respectful = 존중하는 ↔ contemptuous = 경멸하는
det.analysis:
❌ ④ contemptuous(경멸하는): respectful의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① courteous(예의 바른): 유사어
✅ ② polite(공손한): 동의어
✅ ③ considerate(사려 깊은): 유사어
det.tip: respectful(존중하는) ↔ contemptuous/disrespectful(경멸하는)

questions.passage: Students who are in safe learning environments are <u>willing</u> to risk sharing an incorrect answer with their peers in order to grow mathematically.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 willing의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: willing = 기꺼이 하는 ↔ reluctant = 꺼리는
det.analysis:
❌ ③ reluctant(꺼리는): willing의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① eager(열망하는): 유사어
✅ ② ready(준비된): 유사어
✅ ④ inclined(~하려는): 유사어
det.tip: willing(기꺼이 하는) ↔ reluctant/unwilling(꺼리는)

questions.passage: As educators we can model this by recording all answers to be considered without giving any verbal or physical expressions that indicate agreement or disagreement with any answer. The teacher may need to practice having a "blank <u>face</u>."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 face가 이 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: face는 다의어: ① 얼굴 ② 표면 ③ 직면하다 ④ 체면. 이 문맥에서는 교사의 '얼굴 표정(facial expression)'을 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① facial expression(얼굴 표정): blank face = 무표정한 얼굴
❌ ② the front surface of something(표면): 물리적 표면
❌ ③ to deal with something difficult(직면하다): 동사 의미
❌ ④ reputation or dignity(체면): 다른 의미
det.tip: face = 얼굴/표정 | a blank face = 무표정한 얼굴

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a wrong idea or belief that is based on a failure to understand something correctly"

det.korean: "무언가를 올바르게 이해하지 못한 데 기반한 잘못된 생각이나 믿음" = misconception(오개념)
det.analysis:
✅ ② misconception(오개념): 잘못된 이해에 기반한 잘못된 믿음
❌ ① assumption(가정): 증거 없이 사실로 여기는 것
❌ ③ conclusion(결론): 추론의 결과
❌ ④ hypothesis(가설): 검증 대상인 추측
det.tip: misconception = 오개념 (mis- + conception = 잘못된 + 개념)

다음 문장의 부분을 문맥에 맞게 어형 변환하시오.

"The __________(accept) of all ideas is essential for a respectful classroom."

det.analysis: ✅ acceptance(수용): accept(동사)의 명사형
det.tip: accept(수용하다, 동사) → acceptance(수용, 명사) → acceptable(수용할 수 있는, 형용사)

questions.passage: A first step toward establishing a respectful classroom learning community is acceptance of all ideas and answers—regardless of any obvious errors. questions.stem:
다음 문장의 부분을 문맥에 맞게 어형 변환하시오.

"A __________(respect) classroom environment encourages open discussion."

det.korean: respect → respectful(존중하는): classroom 앞에서 형용사가 필요
det.analysis: ✅ respectful(존중하는): respect(명사/동사)의 형용사형
det.tip: respect(존중, 명사/동사) → respectful(존중하는, 형용사) → respectfully(존중하며, 부사)

questions.passage: We must remember that wrong answers are often rooted in misconceptions, and unless these ideas are allowed to be brought to the forefront, we cannot help students confront their thinking.
questions.stem:
"틀린 답은 오개념에 뿌리를 두고 있다"를 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

Wrong answers are often __________ misconceptions.

det.korean: 오개념에 뿌리를 둔 = rooted in misconceptions
det.analysis:
✅ ③ rooted in(뿌리를 둔): 원문 일치
❌ ① derived from(유래된): 뉘앙스 차이
❌ ② connected with(연결된): 느슨한 연결
❌ ④ based upon(기반한): 유사하지만 원문은 rooted in
det.tip: be rooted in = ~에 뿌리를 두다 | root = 뿌리

questions.passage: Part of building a safe learning community is to shift this source of knowledge to the students by equipping them to defend the thinking behind their solutions.
questions.stem:
"학생들이 자신의 풀이 뒤의 사고를 방어하도록 갖추게 하다"를 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 가장 적절한 것은?

__________ them to defend the thinking behind their solutions

det.korean: 학생들을 갖추게 하다 = equipping them
det.analysis:
✅ ④ equipping(갖추게 하는): 원문 일치 — equip A to V
❌ ① requiring(요구하는): 다른 의미
❌ ② preventing(막는): 반대 의미
❌ ③ allowing(허락하는): 유사하나 원문은 equipping
det.tip: equip A to V = A가 V할 수 있도록 갖추게 하다
